events.headline: Anthropic told investors ~$100M annualized rate; $850M targeted for end-2024
events.summary: The Information (via The Fly/TipRanks) reported Anthropic told some investors in about September 2023 it was generating revenue at a $100M annualized rate and then raised its end-2024 target from $500M to $850M annualized.

source.publisher: The Fly via TipRanks (citing The Information)
source.title: Anthropic sees $850M in annualized revenue by 2024 end, The Information says

events.notes: Run-rate (annualized) basis, told to investors; single chain (The Information) with no T1/T2 confirmation. Crunchbase News (Dec 21 2023) separately cites a $200M ARR target as of October 2023, a target not an actual. The 2024 end target ($850M) proved close to the ~$1B actually reached (company: ~$1B at start of 2025).

events.headline: Anthropic projected to burn more than $2.7B cash in 2024
events.summary: TechCrunch, citing The Information, stated Anthropic was projected to burn more than $2.7B in cash in 2024 alongside a further $4B from Amazon.

source.title: Anthropic raises an additional $4B from Amazon, makes AWS its primary cloud partner

events.notes: Projection (cash burn, not net loss). The Information original headline dated 2024-07-24 seen only in Google News RSS (paywalled, not opened). Later WSJ-derived T4 summaries put actual 2024 burn at $5.6B - a large gap vs this mid-year projection and vs the prospectus FY2024 operating loss of $2.98B (different metrics).

events.headline: Reuters-cited projections: $2.2B revenue in 2025, $12B in 2027
events.summary: TechCrunch, citing Reuters, reported Anthropic aimed for $12B of revenue in 2027, up from a projected $2.2B in 2025, while building a dedicated AWS go-to-market team.

source.title: Anthropic forms a new team to grow its AWS business

other.alt_source: The Information Feb 12 2025 headline (paywalled, not opened)

events.notes: Forward projection from investor materials; scenario unstated (The Information Feb 12 2025 headline gave $34.5B for 2027 - possibly an optimistic case; see conflicts). Outcome: recognized FY2025 revenue was ~$4.6B and exit run-rate ~$9B, i.e. 2x-4x this projection. TechCrunch gives no AWS revenue-split detail.

events.headline: The Information: annualized revenue recently crossed $1.4B, up 40% from end-2024
